_comment: The only file a new project has to fill in to adapt the kit. bin/adopt.sh <repo> <audit-folder> writes it with a reasonable start; adjust by hand the fields that depend on the real repo. The other config/ files (dep-boundaries.json, invariants-checks.json, duplication-targets.json, property-hierarchy-map.json) each have their own generic placeholder here and their full example over a critical-flow domain in config/examples/critical-flow/.

rdd._comment: Review receipt (RDD). enabled turns off the whole receipt and hooks system except the absolute set. mode is the default mode for non-absolute hooks (warn logs, block denies or asks); hook_modes overrides it per hook. test_sectors also uses exempt_globs to ignore files. review_authority says who owns the review when another receipt system also runs: kit (this receipt decides) or gentle-ai (its lineage decides delivery and this receipt is only the ledger of the kit checkers).

memory._comment: engram persistent memory (lib/engram_bridge.py). enabled false, or no engram binary on PATH, turns every save into a no-op. engram_project empty falls back to ENGRAM_PROJECT and then to the repo folder's name.

test_sectors._comment: Path -> Gradle tasks map for the touched module, for test_sectors.py. Empty = every source file is unmapped and full_required comes out true (safe default). Full example in config/examples/critical-flow/project.json.
